title: Authoritative source and dependency map
summary: The current Security Effect continuity baseline is Security Effect v0.14 plus Institutional Policy v0.8. Access Permissions v0.2 is the method-authority consumer; Alchemy Security Manager is enforcement. Interaction Event and Relationship Case are integration companions. Crypto v0.8.3 provides semantic identity hashing.
invariants: Security Effect v0.14 is the current executable candidate for this workstream.
Institutional Policy v0.8 remains the current shared policy-governance substrate.
Access Permissions remains a separate authority domain.
Foreign Runtime/Runtime Reference accelerate Crypto qualification but are not Security Effect decision authority.
